interface.shortDescription: One interface for realistic AI voices
interface.longDescription: Use a provider-neutral workflow for realistic AI speech across ElevenLabs, Hume, Cartesia, Resemble AI, OpenAI, Deepgram, Google Cloud Text-to-Speech, and Microsoft Azure Speech. VoxBridge selects provider-specific controls without forcing users to learn eight APIs.
defaultPrompt: Show me the voice providers available through VoxBridge.
Help me choose and preview voices for this script.
Generate this script with the voice provider and settings I specify.

name: voxbridge
description: Generate and manage realistic AI speech through multiple voice providers from one provider-neutral ChatGPT workflow.
